# fptcloud_object_storage_iam_user (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fptcloud_object_storage_iam_user" "example" {
  vpc_id      = "your_vpc_id"
  region_name = "your_region_name"
  user_name   = "app-backend"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region_name` (String) The region name that's are the same with the region name in the S3 service. Currently, we have: HCM-01, HCM-02, HN-01, HN-02
- `user_name` (String) Name of the IAM user. The API has no rename, so changing it replaces the user
- `vpc_id` (String) The VPC ID

### Read-Only

- `access_key_count` (Number) How many access keys the IAM user currently holds
- `arn` (String) The IAM user ARN
- `created_at` (String) When the IAM user was created
- `has_policy` (Boolean) Whether an inline policy is attached to the IAM user
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `path` (String) The IAM user path
- `user_id` (String) The IAM user ID assigned by the storage platform
